title: Default bare slicer ai to instructions
lead: The parent help says "onboarding instructions for coding agents", but the subcommand is required, so a bare call exits 2 with a usage error.
findings_note: another project: bare slicer ai exits 2 even though its help offers onboarding instructions
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing what `instructions` or `skill` print; reading the project; installing the skill.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `ai` registers subparsers with `required=True`. `slicer ai` and `slicer ai --json` never reach the instructions command. `test_Instructions_InvalidSyntax` currently expects that failure.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/cli.py` (the `ai` parser)
- `tests/test_ai.py` (`test_Instructions_InvalidSyntax` and the help test)
- `docs/commands.md` (the `ai` row)
- `CHANGELOG.md`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `slicer ai` and `slicer ai --json` print the same text and JSON as `slicer ai instructions` with the same flags, and exit 0.
2. `slicer ai skill` is unchanged.
3. `slicer ai --help` still lists `instructions` and `skill` and exits 0.
4. `slicer ai unknown` stays exit 2 with code `usage`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Make a missing `ai` subcommand select `instructions`. Do not give the parent parser a `--json` that means something else. An unknown subcommand still fails usage.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: The failing tests pass, then `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests`, `slicer check`, and `git diff --check`.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch, including the re-rendered roadmap and a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased.
